metadata.name: ex8-decision-links-phone
metadata.description: Given the leased disposable decision, when the owner opens it at phone width, then its decision-text link is visible, safely tappable and opens as a new page.

metadata.label: Open the phone decision with the leased link fixture

assert.failure_message: The disposable phone decision renders its linked brief

metadata.label: Read the visible linked brief on the decision

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].find(node=>node.textContent.trim()==='phone-ready project brief');if(!a)throw new Error('decision prose link is missing');const rect=a.getBoundingClientRect(),style=getComputedStyle(a),href=new URL(a.href);if(a.target!=='_blank'||a.rel!=='noopener noreferrer')throw new Error('decision link does not open safely in a new tab');if(rect.width<44||rect.height<44)throw new Error(`decision link is too small to tap: ${rect.width}x${rect.height}`);if(!a.classList.contains('break-words')||a.classList.contains('break-all'))throw new Error('decision link breaks words in the phone heading');if(href.href!=='http://localhost:20001/updates')throw new Error(`unexpected decision link destination ${href.href}`);if(style.pointerEvents==='none')throw new Error('decision prose link cannot receive taps');return {href:href.href,target:a.target,rel:a.rel,width:rect.width,height:rect.height,wordBreak:style.wordBreak,overflowWrap:style.overflowWrap,pointerEvents:style.pointerEvents}})()

metadata.label: Check the phone tap target and safe new-tab destination
Capture the linked decision at 390 pixel phone width
Tap the decision-text link and open its destination in a new page
